description: This file defines a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It includes methods for setting keys, resetting, and computing HMAC results, and defines specific typedefs for common hash algorithms.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: Template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the key for HMAC, hashing it if necessary.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the HMAC computation.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the HMAC computation.
